fails_if: the SCB value reader reads an undelivered label, version, level, validity date or raw cell as a delivered empty one (or the reverse), or keeps an unlabelled blank code as a real empty code
note: A delivered empty code is still a blank code: with no label it is a missing code (maintainer decision 2026-10-08, an unlabelled blank is missing), so both rows read code null and the delivered/undelivered distinction stays in raw_cells and the label. The replaced test claimed the delivered-empty code as ""; that claim changed with the decision. The labelled blank is scb-values-labelled-blank-code-is-the-empty-code.
